title: Bank reconciliation
controls: Import statement (btn-outline-sm with a download/upload arrow svg rotated 180deg, in .top-right)
rr-check tick button on each matched bank line (navy-100 background, check polyline) — 3 of them
rr-check plus button on each unmatched bank line (inline background var(--amber-100), plus icon coloured var(--amber-700)) — 2 of them
rr-check link button on each unmatched GL transaction (navy-100 background, link/paperclip icon) — 2 of them
structure:
The .content block holds exactly three children, in order.

1) .subnav — four .subnav-item divs: "Chart of accounts", "Vendors", "Bills & payments", "Bank reconciliation" (.active).

2) .scope-banner — a full-width navy-100 panel with a 1px navy-200 border, radius 14px, padding 13px 16px, margin-bottom 18px: an 18x18 check-in-circle svg, then a wrapper div containing div.sb1 "Manual matching in this release" and div.sb2 "Match each bank line to a GL transaction yourself for now — automated matching is planned for a future release, not this phase."

3) .recon-layout — a two-equal-column grid (1fr 1fr, gap 16px). Each column is a bare div containing a .recon-col-head (Poppins 13px, space-between) whose trailing element is a span-like div.cnt pill, followed by a white card div with inline style background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--navy-100); border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden holding a stack of .recon-row rows. Each .recon-row is a flex row (padding 11px 14px, bottom border navy-100, none on the last) of div.rr-txt > div.rr1 + div.rr2, then div.rr-amt, then div.rr-check > svg.

LEFT column — head "Bank statement — August" with cnt "2 unmatched"; five rows:
1. rr1 "POS DEP — MAINT FEES", rr2 "Aug 1", rr-amt "$612,400", rr-check default navy with check icon.
2. rr1 "EFT — ISLAND ELECTRIC SVC", rr2 "Aug 5 · prior invoice", rr-amt "$9,650", rr-check default navy with check icon.
3. rr1 "SALARY BATCH — STAFF", rr2 "Aug 28", rr-amt "$323,005", rr-check default navy with check icon.
4. rr1 "EFT — UNKNOWN REF 88213", rr2 "Aug 14", rr-amt "$6,500", rr-check with inline background:var(--amber-100) and a plus svg coloured var(--amber-700).
5. rr1 "BANK FEE — MONTHLY", rr2 "Aug 31", rr-amt "$1,200", rr-check amber with plus svg.

RIGHT column — head "GL transactions — unmatched" with cnt "2 to match"; two rows:
1. rr1 "Bill payment — pending vendor", rr2 "No bank line linked yet", rr-amt "$6,500", rr-check navy with link/paperclip svg.
2. rr1 "Bank charges — unrecorded", rr2 "Needs a journal entry", rr-amt "$1,200", rr-check navy with link svg.
No kpi-row, no data-table and no reconciliation summary/difference box is drawn on this screen.
domain_needs: bank_statement.period_label "August" and account context (the Operating Bank Account, code 1000)
bank_statement.import_source (the "Import statement" action implies an uploaded statement file)
bank_statement_line.description (uppercase bank narrative: "POS DEP — MAINT FEES", "EFT — ISLAND ELECTRIC SVC", "SALARY BATCH — STAFF", "EFT — UNKNOWN REF 88213", "BANK FEE — MONTHLY")
bank_statement_line.date (short format "Aug 1", "Aug 5", "Aug 28", "Aug 14", "Aug 31" — month abbreviation + day, no year)
bank_statement_line.note (optional second clause appended with a middot: "Aug 5 · prior invoice")
bank_statement_line.amount (money, "$" + comma thousands, no decimals; NO sign or debit/credit direction is drawn even though deposits and withdrawals are mixed — direction must be stored separately)
bank_statement_line.match_status (enum: matched | unmatched — drives the rr-check styling: matched = navy-100 background + check icon, unmatched = amber-100 background + plus icon)
bank_statement_line.matched_gl_transaction_id (nullable link)

bank_statement_line.sort_order (drawn order is NOT chronological: Aug 1, Aug 5, Aug 28, Aug 14, Aug 31 — matched lines first, then unmatched; store an explicit order or sort by match_status then date)
gl_transaction.label ("Bill payment — pending vendor", "Bank charges — unrecorded")
gl_transaction.hint / reason ("No bank line linked yet", "Needs a journal entry")
gl_transaction.amount ($6,500, $1,200)
gl_transaction.match_status = unmatched, gl_transaction.matched_bank_line_id (nullable)
gl_transaction.requires_journal_entry (boolean — the bank-charges row says "Needs a journal entry")
count.bank_unmatched "2 unmatched" — DERIVED: count of left-column rows with match_status = unmatched (rows 4 and 5)
count.gl_to_match "2 to match" — DERIVED: count of right-column unmatched GL transactions
reconciliation.mode = manual (feature flag) — the scope banner text is fixed copy for this release
reconciliation.period (August) and estate scoping
reconciliation actions: tick/confirm a matched line, plus-button to create or attach a match on an unmatched bank line, link-button to attach a GL transaction to a bank line

accounting_notes:
Manual bank reconciliation of the Operating Bank Account (account 1000, balance $3,890,214 on screen 25) for the period "Bank statement — August". No automated matching: the scope banner states verbatim "Manual matching in this release" / "Match each bank line to a GL transaction yourself for now — automated matching is planned for a future release, not this phase."
BANK SIDE (5 lines, drawn without +/- signs — direction must be inferred): POS DEP — MAINT FEES, Aug 1, $612,400 (MATCHED — a deposit of maintenance fees, Dr 1000 / Cr 1200 Dues Receivable, feeding 4000 Maintenance Fee Income); EFT — ISLAND ELECTRIC SVC, Aug 5 · prior invoice, $9,650 (MATCHED — a withdrawal settling a prior Island Electric invoice, Dr 2000 Accounts Payable / Cr 1000; it is a PRIOR invoice, so it is not one of the open bills on screen 27); SALARY BATCH — STAFF, Aug 28, $323,005 (MATCHED — net payroll withdrawal; $323,005 + $116,995 Statutory Deductions Payable (account 2100) = $440,000, consistent with gross payroll Dr 5000 Staff Payroll $440,000 / Cr 1000 $323,005 / Cr 2100 $116,995); EFT — UNKNOWN REF 88213, Aug 14, $6,500 (UNMATCHED, amber plus button); BANK FEE — MONTHLY, Aug 31, $1,200 (UNMATCHED, amber plus button).
GL SIDE — "GL transactions — unmatched", 2 to match: "Bill payment — pending vendor" / "No bank line linked yet" / $6,500; "Bank charges — unrecorded" / "Needs a journal entry" / $1,200.
THE TWO OUTSTANDING MATCHES ARE EXACT AMOUNT PAIRS: bank line "EFT — UNKNOWN REF 88213" $6,500 ↔ GL "Bill payment — pending vendor" $6,500 (a payment already posted in the GL, Dr 2000 / Cr 1000, whose bank leg is unidentified); bank line "BANK FEE — MONTHLY" $1,200 ↔ GL "Bank charges — unrecorded" $1,200 (a bank-only item with no GL entry yet — clearing it requires a new journal entry Dr bank charges expense $1,200 / Cr 1000 Operating Bank Account $1,200). The two counts agree: "2 unmatched" on the bank side equals "2 to match" on the GL side, so after both matches the August reconciliation closes with zero unmatched items on either side.
No reconciliation summary is drawn — there is no statement opening balance, closing balance, book balance or difference figure on this screen; the rebuild must not invent one, but a real reconciliation would need statement_opening_balance, statement_closing_balance, book_balance and the derived difference (which the two $6,500 / $1,200 items currently explain).
